claims.cpu: Process CPU total including target-side diagnostic cost, not per-stack CPU attribution
claims.samples: Managed sampled-thread-time categories, not on-CPU percentages
claims.allocation: Managed total bytes and allocation samples; not exact per-type or native allocation accounting
claims.waits: Monitor contention and managed WaitHandle observations can overlap; never summed into CPU or total wall time
claims.comparison: One untraced reference is only a severe-perturbation check; no QPS/P99 targets or precise collector overhead estimate
claims.unknown: Unknown stacks and incomplete/lost events are disclosed, never silently assigned to a hotspot
